decisive_items: irregular mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast
tumor cells presented variety of arrangement patterns including vesicular, tubular, and striated patterns
response.rationale: Imaging shows an irregular mass with axillary lymphadenopathy and PET-CT uptake; FNAC reveals malignant epithelial patterns with E-cadherin positivity, consistent with invasive ductal carcinoma. R8 is a broad category subsumed by R1, while other candidates lack specific pathological or molecular support.

rejected.why: Only AR positivity is mentioned; no ER status provided, so estrogen receptor-positive cannot be confirmed.
No HER2 testing or result is reported; absence of mention does not establish HER2-negative status.
Imaging shows irregular hypoechoic areas, calcifications, and abnormal uptake, contradicting benign fibroadenoma.
No leaf-like architecture or specific phyllodes features; pathological pattern and IHC favor ductal carcinoma.
Lymph node positivity is a staging feature, not a primary diagnosis; it is secondary to the breast malignancy.
